summary: Rebrand-to-Naparstek-Digital test pass. Backend pytest 6/6 green (root, create inquiry, minimal, invalid-email 422, missing-required 422, GET sort). Verified new email-alert flow: backend logs show httpx POST to integrations.emergentagent.com/api/v1/email/send returning 202 Accepted for each POST /api/inquiries. Save is non-blocking on email failure. Frontend: all 6 routes (page-home/work/services/process/about/contact) render via nav-link-* selectors. About page contains '16', 'Olathe', 'Kansas' and about-monogram is present. Contact page shows contact-email-link=mailto:hello@naparstekdigital.com and contact-phone-link=tel:9139059935. Footer shows footer-email=hello@naparstekdigital.com and footer-phone=913.905.9935. Empty submit did not show the success panel (form correctly blocked; success toast selector was not captured in generic role=status query but functional behavior verified — no POST fired, no contact-success panel). Full contact form submission with shadcn Select for need & budget succeeded; contact-success panel rendered; inquiry persisted via GET /api/inquiries.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py send_email is properly wrapped in try/except inside create_inquiry so DB save is not affected by email failure — good.
seed_data_creation: TEST_ and TESTUI_ prefixed inquiries left in DB (add-only endpoints). Each triggers a real owner-email 202 to a.naparstek@icloud.com via Emergent proxy.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Rebrand + email alert verified end-to-end. shadcn Select needs ~400ms wait after opening before clicking option (handled). Empty-submit toast uses a custom container; if you need to assert its text specifically, look for the 'Your inquiry has been sent' / validation text near bottom-right rather than role=status.
